rubrics_metrics.description: Nothing in any portion of the book recording my sister's own observations or opinions has been omitted or changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor states he has left unchanged all expressions of Margaret Fuller's opinion and feeling, even when they may have been gradually modified by ensuing events; verbal emendations may have been made where manuscript was not available but substantive opinions remain intact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omissions limited to keep single-volume unity
rubrics_metrics.description: Omissions were made to bring the work within the compass of one volume and were chosen so as not materially to diminish its value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omissions principally occur in 'Summer on the Lakes' and consist of extracts from other writers, translations, some letters and poems, and episodical material; the editor believed the unity of the narrative preserved and notes which types of material were omitted and that more will appear in a later volume.
